question.text: Will Ekrem İmamoğlu be convicted of a crime during Q4 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as Yes if during October, November, or December 2026, Ekrem İmamoğlu is convicted of a crime by a Turkish criminal court.
question.fine_print: This question refers to receiving a guilty verdict. Pending appeals will not prevent this question from resolving Yes.

research:
İmamoğlu has not been convicted so far in Q4 2026. The likeliest route to a Yes is the CHP congress vote-rigging case in Ankara, which resumes on 2026-11-11. The prosecutor gave his final sentencing opinion in that case on 2026-10-21, a step that usually comes just before a verdict. Two more cases have hearings in December.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question names no specific URL or dataset. It resolves on Turkish court verdicts, as reported by Turkish media (Hürriyet, Bianet, Diken, Habertürk) and international outlets. There is no data file to read.
- I found no report of a guilty verdict against İmamoğlu dated October 1 through November 4, 2026.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. His most recent conviction came just before the window, so it does not count:
- 2026-09-11: In a retrial over remarks about former Tuzla mayor Şadi Yazıcı, he was sentenced to 2 years 1 month for publicly insulting a public official, plus a political ban. He had been acquitted twice before in this case, and both acquittals were overturned. [Euronews TR](https://tr.euronews.com/2026/09/11/ekrem-imamogluna-2-yil-1-ay-hapis-ve-siyasi-yasak-karari), [Turkish Minute](https://www.turkishminute.com/2026/09/11/jailed-istanbul-mayor-imamoglu-sentenced-to-2-years-in-insult-case/)
- 2026-10-13 (around): His lawyers appealed the Tuzla verdict to the regional appeals court. [Cumhuriyet](https://www.cumhuriyet.com.tr/siyaset/son-dakika-imamoglu-ndan-tuzla-davasina-istinaf-basvurusu-2546295)
- He is still in custody.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-04: The 104th hearing of the main İBB "crime organisation" trial began at the Istanbul 33rd Heavy Penal Court, with secret witnesses testifying. There are 436 defendants, 46 of them detained, and prosecutors seek 828 to 2,352 years for İmamoğlu. The trial is still hearing witnesses, so a verdict before year end looks very unlikely. [Hürriyet](https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/gundem/imamoglu-davasinda-104-durusma-basladi-gizli-taniklar-dinleniyor-43365602), [Habertürk](https://www.haberturk.com/gundem/ibb-davasinda-durusma-4-kasim-a-ertelendi-3924687)
- 2026-11-02: The current two-week block of the İBB trial opened. İmamoğlu called the trial "illegitimate". [BirGün](https://www.birgun.net/haber/ibb-davasinda-3-uncu-celsenin-ilk-gunu-tamamlandi-imamoglu-ndan-mahkeme-baskanina-tepki-743961)
- 2026-10-21: CHP 38th Congress criminal case, Ankara 26th Criminal Court of First Instance:
  - The prosecutor asked for 9 defendants, including İmamoğlu, to be punished for "vote rigging" under Article 112 of the Political Parties Law, which carries 1 to 3 years.
  - He asked for 3 defendants to be acquitted, including Cemil Tugay, the İzmir mayor who has since joined the AKP.
  - The court adjourned to 2026-11-11 at 10:00 so the defence can respond to the opinion. [Bianet](https://bianet.org/haber/chp-kurultay-davasi-nda-imamoglu-na-hapis-akp-ye-gecen-izbb-baskani-tugay-a-beraat-talebi-324684), [Haberler](https://www.haberler.com/guncel/chp-kurultayi-davasinda-savci-imamoglu-dahil-9-20351646-haberi/)
- 2026-09-29: In the "political espionage" case, the Istanbul 25th Heavy Penal Court kept all 4 defendants in detention and adjourned to December 23. Prosecutors seek up to 20 years each. [Diken](https://www.diken.com.tr/casusluk-davasi-imamoglu-dahil-dort-isim-icin-tutukluluga-devam-karari-2/)
- 2026-07-13: The expert-witness case (charge: trying to influence a fair trial) was adjourned to 2026-12-08 because a new prosecutor asked for more time. [Takvim](https://www.takvim.com.tr/guncel/2026/07/13/imamoglunun-bilirkisi-davasi-8-aralika-ertelendi), [DHA](https://www.dha.com.tr/gundem/imamoglunun-yargilandigi-bilirkisi-davasinda-durusma-8-aralika-ertelendi-2908808)
- 2026-07-06: The diploma forgery case (Istanbul 59th Criminal Court of First Instance; 2 years 6 months to 8 years 9 months sought) was adjourned to 2026-12-25. The court is waiting to hear whether the administrative court ruling against İmamoğlu's challenge to the diploma annulment is final. [Beyaz Gazete](https://beyazgazete.com/haber/2026/7/6/ekrem-imamoglu-nun-diploma-davasi-25-aralik-a-ertelendi-7174462.html)
- The 2022 YSK "fool" ("ahmak") insult conviction was upheld on appeal on 2025-09-19 and is now at the Court of Cassation (Yargıtay). I found no ruling yet. If it were upheld, that probably would not count as a new conviction, but this is ambiguous. [Medyascope](https://medyascope.tv/2025/09/19/istinaf-imamoglu-na-ahmak-davasinda-verilen-cezayi-onadi/)

## 4. Base rates
Trial-court outcomes for İmamoğlu so far, from a Turkish Wikipedia summary current to about July 2026, plus news reports:
- **Convictions:**
  - YSK insult case, 2022-12-14
  - Ordu governor insult case (a fine), 2021
  - Akın Gürlek insult/threat case, 2025-07-16
  - Tuzla retrial, 2026-09-11
- **Acquittals:**
  - Beylikdüzü tender case, 2025-10-24
  - Tuzla case twice, later overturned
- **Dropped after he paid a pre-trial settlement (ön ödeme):**
  - Insulting prosecutors case, 2025-10-18
  - Serkan Şahin insult case, 2026-03-05

That is about 4 convictions in roughly 4 years, with 2 of them in the last 15 months.
- Once a Turkish trial court hears the prosecutor's final opinion, it often rules at the next one or two hearings, though adjournments are common. I could not find a systematic statistic on this.
- Political cases against opposition figures have mostly ended in conviction lately.
- [Turkish Wikipedia list of cases](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu_hakk%C4%B1ndaki_davalar_ve_soru%C5%9Fturmalar)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on whether he will be convicted in Q4 2026.
- Related markets, prices taken 2026-11-04:
  - Polymarket "İmamoğlu released from custody in 2026?": Yes at 4.8%.
  - Kalshi, winner of the next Turkish presidential election: İmamoğlu at 12%.
  - Kalshi, first-round winner in 2028: İmamoğlu at 20%.
- None of these directly measures a conviction.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-11: CHP congress case, Ankara 26th Criminal Court of First Instance. The defence responds to the prosecutor's opinion, and a verdict is possible. This is the key event.
- 2026-12-08: Expert-witness case. A new prosecutor still has to give his opinion. Note: his lawyers had made a pre-trial settlement payment earlier in this case, which in other cases led to dismissal.
- 2026-12-23: Espionage case. The court was still trying to locate witnesses, so a verdict seems less likely.
- 2026-12-25: Diploma forgery case. Its timing depends on whether the administrative court ruling is final.
- Ongoing: İBB main trial sessions. A verdict before year end looks very unlikely.
- At any time: a possible Yargıtay ruling on the YSK case, though upholding an existing conviction may not count as a new one.

# Research brief: Will Ekrem İmamoğlu be convicted of a crime in Q4 2026?

**Short answer:** I found no guilty verdict between 1 October and 3 November 2026. The likeliest route to a Yes is the CHP congress vote-rigging case. The prosecutor has already asked the court to convict, and the next hearing is on 11 November.

## 1. Resolution source
- There is no single official data series. The question resolves on whether any Turkish criminal court finds İmamoğlu guilty, which would show up in court reporting (AA, Hürriyet, Medyascope, Turkish Minute and similar).
- Late July 2026: Turkish Wikipedia's list of his cases showed no new criminal conviction in 2026 up to that point. [tr.wikipedia](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu_hakk%C4%B1ndaki_davalar_ve_soru%C5%9Fturmalar)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The most recent conviction I found was on 2026-09-11, which is before Q4 and does not count.
- 2026-09-11: A court sentenced him to about 2 years 1 month, with a possible political ban, for insulting former Tuzla mayor Şadi Yazıcı. This was a retrial after two acquittals were overturned. [Turkish Minute](https://www.turkishminute.com/2026/09/11/jailed-istanbul-mayor-imamoglu-sentenced-to-2-years-in-insult-case/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-04: The 104th hearing in the main İBB corruption case started at Istanbul 33rd Heavy Penal Court, hearing secret witnesses. There are 436 defendants, 46 of them detained. A separate indictment over tree and landscaping tenders has been merged into the case, seeking 62 to 168 years for İmamoğlu. [Hürriyet](https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/gundem/imamoglu-davasinda-104-durusma-basladi-gizli-taniklar-dinleniyor-43365602)
- 2026-11-02/03: The third session of hearings began and is expected to run about two weeks. Businessmen testified about alleged bribes. Prosecutors seek 828 to 2,352 years. The trial is still taking evidence, with no prosecutor's final opinion (mütalaa) yet. [Habertürk](https://www.haberturk.com/gundem/ibb-davasinda-durusma-4-kasim-a-ertelendi-3924687), [Takvim](https://www.takvim.com.tr/guncel/2026/11/03/ibb-davasinda-is-adami-itiraf-etti-4-milyon-dolari-cantayla-teslim-ettim)
- 2026-10-21: **CHP 38th Congress vote-rigging case** (Ankara 26th Criminal Court of First Instance): the prosecutor gave his final opinion, asking for convictions of 9 defendants, including İmamoğlu, under the Political Parties Law, with up to 3 years in prison (some outlets say 1 to 3 years). He asked for acquittal of 3 others, including Cemil Tugay. The case was adjourned to **11 November**. No source says whether that hearing is meant for final defences or a verdict. [NTV](https://www.ntv.com.tr/turkiye/chpnin-kurultay-davasinda-mutalaa-1747325), [İstiklal](https://www.istiklal.com.tr/siyaset/chpnin-kurultay-davasinda-ekrem-imamoglu-icin-hapis-talebi-1108701h)
- 2026-10-14/15: İmamoğlu gave his defence in the İBB trial. [Medyascope](https://medyascope.tv/2026/10/14/ekrem-imamoglunun-savunmasinin-tam-metni-14-ekim-2026-aynaya-baktilar-gorduklerini-benim-adima-iddianameye-yazdilar/)
- 2026-09-29: In the "political espionage" case (Istanbul 25th Heavy Penal Court, 15 to 20 years sought), the court kept him in detention and adjourned to **23 December 2026**. [Diken](https://www.diken.com.tr/casusluk-davasi-imamoglu-dahil-dort-isim-icin-tutukluluga-devam-karari-2/)
- About 2026-09-22: A new "official car" abuse-of-office case was filed (up to 2 years sought). It was later adjourned to 12 February 2027 for a new expert report. [Bianet](https://bianet.org/haber/ekrem-imamogluna-yeni-dava-317220), [24 Saat](https://www.24saatgazetesi.com/imamoglunun-makam-araci-davasi-12-subat-2027ye-ertelendi)
- 2026-07-13: The expert-witness case was adjourned to **8 December 2026** because a new prosecutor asked for more time. The previous prosecutor had said the main charge (TCK 277) was not made out. The remaining charge (TCK 288) qualifies for "ön ödeme", a payment that can end the case without a verdict, and his lawyers have already paid it. Reports suggest the case may be dropped rather than end in conviction. [Takvim](https://www.takvim.com.tr/guncel/2026/07/13/imamoglunun-bilirkisi-davasi-8-aralika-ertelendi)
- 2026-07-06: The diploma forgery case was adjourned to **25 December 2026**. The court is waiting for the administrative court to confirm whether the cancellation of his diploma is final. [Medyascope](https://medyascope.tv/2026/07/06/durusmasi-ertelendi-imamoglu-diploma-davasinda-ne-anlatti/), [İlkses](https://ilkses.com.tr/gundem/imamoglu-nun-diploma-davasinda-besinci-durusma-452509)

## 4. Base rates
- First-instance criminal convictions I found:
  - 2021-03: fine for insulting the Ordu governor
  - 2022-12: 2 years 7 months for insulting election board (YSK) members
  - 2025-07-16: 1 year 8 months for insulting and threatening prosecutor Akın Gürlek
  - 2026-09-11: about 2 years 1 month in the Yazıcı insult case

  [Turkish Minute](https://www.turkishminute.com/2026/09/11/jailed-istanbul-mayor-imamoglu-sentenced-to-2-years-in-insult-case/), [Türkiye Today](https://www.turkiyetoday.com/nation/imamoglu-gets-1-year-8-months-for-insult-and-threat-in-turkiye-3204326)
- That is about 2 convictions in the past 15 months, roughly 0.4 per quarter.
- Not every case ends in conviction. He was acquitted in the Beylikdüzü tender case (2025-10-24). Two insult cases were dismissed after ön ödeme payments (2025-10-18 and 2026-03-05). [tr.wikipedia](https://tr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ekrem_%C4%B0mamo%C4%9Flu_hakk%C4%B1ndaki_davalar_ve_soru%C5%9Fturmalar)
- Turkish first-instance (asliye ceza) courts often rule at the hearing right after the prosecutor's final opinion, or one hearing later. This is a general pattern, not something verified for this case.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no market on this exact question.
- Polymarket, "İmamoğlu released from custody in 2026?": Yes at 4.8% (as of 2026-11-04). This is only indirectly related.
- Kalshi, Turkish presidential election: İmamoğlu at 0.12 to win and 0.20 to win the first round in 2028. Not directly relevant.

## 6. Upcoming events before 31 December
- **2026-11-11: CHP congress vote-rigging case hearing (Ankara).** The prosecutor's final opinion is already in, so this is the most likely conviction point. The hearing could be postponed for final defences.
- 2026-11 (ongoing): third session of the İBB corruption trial. A verdict in Q4 is very unlikely because evidence is still being heard.
- 2026-12-08: expert-witness case. A conviction looks less likely given the ön ödeme payment and the earlier prosecutor's view.
- 2026-12-23: espionage case hearing. No prosecutor's final opinion has been reported.
- 2026-12-25: diploma forgery case hearing, which depends on the administrative court's ruling.
- Bakırköy prosecutors opened three probes into his courtroom remarks (March, April and July 2026), including one for "threatening a public official". They could become new cases, but none would plausibly reach a verdict in Q4.

I could not confirm the procedural purpose of the 11 November hearing or whether it has been rescheduled.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) About 8 weeks remain, until December 31, 2026. Yes requires a Turkish criminal court to issue a guilty verdict against İmamoğlu between October 1 and December 31, 2026. A pending appeal does not matter. None has happened yet as of November 4.

(b) Status quo: if nothing changed, there would be no new verdict before year end and the question resolves No. However, the CHP congress case is at the verdict stage, so the status quo here is not simply "nothing happens."

(c) Base rate: İmamoğlu has had about 4 trial-court convictions in roughly 4 years, 2 of them in the last 15 months. That gives a naive rate of about 25-35% for any given quarter. A better reference class is Turkish first-instance trials where the prosecutor's final opinion (mütalaa) has been given and the defence has been granted time to respond. These often end in a verdict at the next hearing or the one after, perhaps 50-65% within about 2 months. In politically charged cases against opposition figures, verdicts have mostly been convictions, roughly 80-90%.

(d) Evidence:
- **For Yes:**
  - On October 21, 2026, the prosecutor asked for İmamoğlu to be punished under Article 112 of the Political Parties Law. The defence responds on November 11, after which a verdict can be given that day or at a December hearing.
  - Three more cases have hearings in December: the expert-witness case on December 8, espionage on December 23 and the diploma case on December 25.
  - He was convicted in the Tuzla retrial on September 11, 2026, which shows courts are willing to convict.
- **For No:**
  - Turkish courts adjourn often, and with 12 defendants the defence statements may take a whole session.
  - Political timing, for example links to the CHP "absolute nullity" litigation, could push the ruling into 2027.
  - A deferral of the announcement of the verdict (HAGB) on a 1-3 year count is possible, and would arguably not count as a conviction.
  - The December cases look unready. The expert-witness case has a new prosecutor, the espionage court is still locating witnesses, and the diploma case depends on whether the administrative ruling is final.
  - The main İBB trial is nowhere near a verdict.

(e) Scenarios:
- **No:** On November 11 the defence asks for more time, and the court adjourns to January or February 2027. The December hearings in the other cases end in further adjournments.
- **Yes:** On November 11, or at a December follow-up hearing, the Ankara 26th Criminal Court of First Instance sentences İmamoğlu to between 1 and 3 years for vote rigging.

(f) Reasoning: I put the chance of a verdict in the CHP case in Q4 at about 60%, and the chance that a verdict is a guilty one that counts (not an acquittal, and not an HAGB that fails to count) at about 85%. That gives about 51%. The other three December cases add perhaps another 8-10% of independent chance. Overall that is roughly 55-58%. This moves well up from the naive base rate of about 30% because a key case is at the verdict stage. I stay below 65% because adjournments are common.

Probability: 56%

**(a) Time left and what Yes requires.** There are about 8 weeks left, to December 31, 2026. Yes requires a Turkish criminal trial court to return a guilty verdict against İmamoğlu between October 1 and December 31, 2026. A pending appeal does not prevent Yes. No qualifying verdict has occurred so far in October or early November.

**(b) Status quo.** If nothing changed, the answer would be No. The Tuzla conviction on 2026-09-11 falls just before the window, and none of the other cases has reached a verdict.

**(c) Base rate.** İmamoğlu has about 4 trial-court convictions in roughly 4 years, 2 of them in the last 15 months. That gives roughly a 15-25% chance of a conviction in any given quarter. The relevant reference class is narrower, though: Turkish first-instance cases where the prosecutor has given his final sentencing opinion and the next hearing is set for the defence to respond. In those cases a verdict usually follows within one or two hearings, often 50-70% at the next one. Political cases against opposition figures have mostly ended in conviction lately.

**(d) Strongest evidence.**
- **For Yes:**
  - 2026-10-21: In the CHP congress case, the prosecutor asked for İmamoğlu to be punished for vote rigging (1-3 years).
  - 2026-11-11: That case resumes for the defence's response to the prosecutor's opinion, so a verdict that day or at a December hearing is plausible.
  - Additional December hearings in the expert-witness case (Dec 8), espionage case (Dec 23) and diploma case (Dec 25) give extra, smaller chances.
  - The courts have recently been willing to convict him, as in the Tuzla retrial after two acquittals.
